text.aria-label: Subtitle text '13 Primary substations with at least 24 months of data, January 2022 to June 2026. Residual: observed power minus experiment 17's model frozen at its first origin, ERA5 weather. Dot: median over series of each series' straight-line slope of monthly residual. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months. Positive: demand above the frozen forecast.'
text.tspan: 13 Primary substations with at least 24 months of data, January 2022 to June 2026. Residual:
observed power minus experiment 17's model frozen at its first origin, ERA5 weather.
Dot: median over series of each series' straight-line slope of monthly residual.
Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months.
Positive: demand above the frozen forecast.
